## Decision Filter

Per the [thesis](../blob/main/docs/thesis.md), every change must pass:

## Checklist

- [ ] Preserves the canonical identity.
- [ ] Preserves the canonical research question.
- [ ] Preserves the canonical sequence: Observation → Pattern → Abstraction → Primitive → Transfer.
- [ ] Does not introduce runtime, infrastructure, execution, authority, legitimacy, proof, or governance claims as MindShift functionality.
